# skills.md — UC-0C Number That Looks Right
# Generated by prompting an AI assistant, then manually refined. Delete the template comment before committing.

skills:
  - name: load_dataset
    description: Reads the ward budget CSV, validates the required columns, and reports every null actual_spend row with its notes reason before any computation.
    input: Path to a CSV with columns period, ward, category, budgeted_amount, actual_spend, notes.
    output: List of row dicts with actual parsed as float (or None when blank), plus a printed report of null rows and their notes reasons.
    error_handling: Refuses (exit 2) if the file is missing or any required column is absent; null actual_spend is never treated as zero.

  - name: compute_growth
    description: Computes a per-period MoM or YoY growth table for exactly one ward and one category, showing the formula used in every row.
    input: dataset rows, exact ward name, exact category name, growth type (MoM or YoY).
    output: List of per-period rows with actual_spend, compared_with, previous_actual_spend, growth_pct, formula, status (OK / NULL_FLAGGED / PRIOR_NULL_FLAGGED / NO_PRIOR_PERIOD / DIVIDE_BY_ZERO) and note.
    error_handling: Refuses (exit 2) if the row set is empty; null current period is NULL_FLAGGED, null previous period is PRIOR_NULL_FLAGGED, missing previous period is NO_PRIOR_PERIOD, zero previous spend is DIVIDE_BY_ZERO — growth is only ever computed between two real, non-null values.
